content: pgvector-elixir (hex package 'pgvector', latest 0.4.0) supports Ecto and Postgrex, :vector/:halfvec/:bit/:sparsevec column types, HNSW and IVFFlat index creation via Ecto migrations, and ships a hybrid search (tsvector + vector, Reciprocal Rank Fusion) example using Bumblebee in its repo examples folder.
